note: The sentences `daoris place landing`, `helpers` and `commits` say as a rule is set, which Ask Daoris's cards say too (TWINWORDS1, D164's DOORS1a note). The CLI's driverconfig.ts and the driver's HelpSettingProposals each say them from their own code; each suite reads this table, so a change to one side's words fails the other's test.

helpers.says: Each helper an agent asks for waits for your yes.
A helper an agent asks for starts at once, within the limits: two at once for a session, one turn each.
A helper is not offered to a session here: only your own press asks one.

commits.says: Each piece that passes its checks is committed as the work goes.
Each commit waits for your yes before it is made.
One commit is made when the work is done.
